walkthroughs.body_html:
Sport and Society and the Role of Technology in Physical Activity and Sport — a core area of A-Level PE.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Sport and Society and the Role of Technology in Physical Activity and Sport brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Sport and Society and the Role of Technology in Physical Activity and Sport.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
